items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: they all would play like Sidney Bechet

ctx.x: I heard him, yeah, 1945. How did he play? Pretty good. Yeah, he was a good player. He hadn't been playing, he'd been working in a shipyard or something out in California during the war, and he went back to the clarinet, he sounded a little bit like Johnny Dodds. Do you remember Johnny Dodds?

Yeah, I know Johnny, he was a routine. I didn't count him. Now when I get to that class, on that kind of class was Sidney Bechet at that time, they all would play like Sidney Bechet, Johnny Dodds, Muley, Muley Bond. Well, they all could jam at that time around the same thing. It was old time, but they played in, uh, Georgie Boy. Yeah, I never knew him.
